description.value: The Miyazaki Heritage House is a beautifully preserved Second Empire-style home in Lillooet with a distinctive mansard roof and ornate dormer windows, a rare architectural style for rural British Columbia. The house serves as a history museum with historic photos, antiques, and a gift shop, telling the stories of the prominent families who lived there, including Doctor Masajiro Miyazaki. It also hosts community art exhibits, music concerts, and cultural events on its grounds throughout the warmer months.
